gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the only named bench test of an APsystems EZ1 we could find (Smartzone, 20 Dec 2024, on the EU EZ1-M) measured 93/94/96% efficiency at 200/400/800 W, a mean of 94.3%, below the 96.7–97.3% peak APsystems quotes, and saw no power fed in until 28 V against the maker's 16 V.
standout_why: I opened solarwaypoint.com (cited), balconysolarkits.us/kits (cited) and howtogosolar.org (top result). Solar Waypoint says its picks are 'editorial assessments, not hands-on performance tests'. Balconysolarkits.us lists only ratings, prices and certifications and cites no lab tests. Howtogosolar gives no efficiency figures and names no measurer. None of the three gives a figure that a named reviewer or lab measured for any candidate. The finding comes with two limits: it is for the 230 V EU sibling, not the US EZ1-LV, and it used uncalibrated meters.
decides: It confirms the EZ1 as a sound pick rather than changing it. The one named bench test found it holds a clean 810 W cap and converts about 94% of DC to AC, so the page should plan yield on about 94%, not the 97% on the spec sheet. It also tells shoppers with weak or shaded panels that the inverter may not start feeding until about 28 V of panel voltage. No named US measurement exists for the EZ1-LV, the Hoymiles HiFlow Pro LV or the US EcoFlow STREAM, so on measured performance none of them can be ranked above the others. Certification and price should still decide the pick.

findings.label: Annual yield measured by Stiftung Warentest across 8 kits
findings.value: 860–1,020 kWh/yr on an example roof; 600–720 kWh/yr on a balcony railing
findings.source_title: Energiewende auf dem Balkon: Mehrere Balkonkraftwerke versagen im Belastungstest (Stiftung Warentest, 22.05.2025)
findings.note: These are whole-kit figures for German sun, and the press release does not name the kits. It says the bundled inverters were 'diesmal kein größeres Problem'. Five of the 8 kits were rated mangelhaft for weak mounts.

findings.label: Stiftung Warentest interference finding
findings.value: One inverter used by several kit sellers can interfere with other devices and radio links, and the Bundesnetzagentur pulled it from the market for review
findings.source_title: Balkonkraftwerke: Nur die günstigste Solaranlage ist gut (Stiftung Warentest, 25.04.2024)
findings.note: 1 of 8 kits rated gut. The press release does not name the inverter's maker. With a quarter of the module area shaded, the best kits delivered just over half their output.
